# Asher Falcon

> Asher Falcon is an 18-year-old student and software engineer interested in programming and mathematics, studying computer science, maths, and chemistry. This site is a personal portfolio and blog covering programming projects, ideas, and learning.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ashfn.com/): Introduction and links.
- [Blog](https://ashfn.com/blog/): Posts on software engineering, maths, and side projects.
- [Projects](https://ashfn.com/projects/): A showcase of personal and software projects.
- [Contact](https://ashfn.com/contact/): Ways to get in touch.

## Blog posts

- [Live public transport routing](https://ashfn.com/blog/posts/5/): How public transit routers like Google Maps and CityMapper work, and building one for London supporting buses, tubes, and trains.
- [Game of Life with Braille](https://ashfn.com/blog/posts/4/): Rendering Conway's Game of Life in the terminal using 2x4 Unicode braille characters in C++.
- [Hiding messages in playing cards](https://ashfn.com/blog/posts/3/): Storing arbitrary data in the ordering of a 52-card deck using factoradic/permutation encoding.
- [Storing images in DNS TXT records](https://ashfn.com/blog/posts/2/): Experiments storing image data inside DNS TXT records.
- [Docker deployment](https://ashfn.com/blog/posts/1/): A shell script to automate deploying a docker-compose file to a server.
- [Hello](https://ashfn.com/blog/posts/0/): A welcome post and test of the blog.
